description: VoiceIsolate Pro ONNX model registry — all models execute locally via onnxruntime-web (WebGPU → WASM fallback). NO cloud inference. Models are fetched from same-origin /app/models/*.onnx; vercel.json rewrites resolve those paths to public Vercel Blob URLs. Once cached in Cache API (vip-models-v1), zero network on repeat visits.

models.purpose: Voice Activity Detection — gates the pipeline before heavy ML stages
RNNoise — lightweight broadband noise suppressor, always-on stage 1
models.export_notes: PyTorch GRU approximation (3 layers, hidden=24) at random init. Architecturally equivalent to RNNoise but weights are not trained. ml-worker passes magnitudes (length numBins=1025) which mismatches the model's expected input shape [1, 480]; the runtime catch handles this and the stage is a graceful no-op until weights and bin-binding are wired.

models.purpose: Hybrid Demucs v4 — primary vocals / accompaniment source separation
models.export_notes: Blocked: HDemucs uses internal torch.stft on complex tensors. torch.onnx.export at opset 17 fails with SymbolicValueError ('STFT does not currently support complex types'); opset 20 succeeds tracing but OOMs at graph emit on 5GB-disk hosts. mdx_extra is shipped as a BagOfModels (4 sub-models): unwrap to bag.models[0] for traceability. Demucs v4 has no pure-waveform variant in 4.x. Until shipped, ml-worker.js falls back to BSRNN-only or DSP-only path.

models.purpose: Band-Split RNN — secondary vocals extractor used in Studio/Forensic mode
models.export_notes: Pure-PyTorch BSRNN architecture (vendor BandSplitRNN-Pytorch unusable: pins torch==1.13.1 not on Python 3.12, and pytorch_lightning import fails). Exported with random weights via scripts/export_bsrnn_onnx.py — output is noise until a trained MUSDB18 checkpoint is dropped at ./checkpoints/bsrnn.pth and re-exported. ml-worker.js does not currently call this session, so shipping the stub is safe and unblocks integrity checks.

delivery_notes: silero_vad.onnx, rnnoise_suppressor.onnx, and bsrnn_vocals.onnx are committed to the repo and served directly by Vercel from public/app/models/ at same-origin /app/models/<name>.onnx.
demucs_v4_quantized.onnx is not yet exportable (see entry export_notes); a .placeholder file holds the slot. ml-worker.js detects a missing or under-sized file and disables the Demucs stage cleanly.
Same-origin fetch keeps COEP (require-corp) satisfied so SharedArrayBuffer stays alive.
After first run all models are served from Cache API (vip-models-v1) — zero network on repeat visits.
The service worker (sw.js) intercepts /app/models/*.onnx fetches and returns the cached binary to ml-worker.js.
100% local processing guarantee preserved — no audio data leaves the browser.

model_loader_behavior.download_ui: Show progress modal with per-model MB progress bar. Demucs (when shipped) must show estimated time. Do not block UI thread during fetch.
model_loader_behavior.integrity_check: sha256 field — leave empty to skip check, populate after upload to enable.
